Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical running-rehabilitation note for March 21-25, 2025. Record the first continuous run result, the limit for the rest of March, and the next planned short run.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Running Rehabilitation Note — March 21–25, 2025", "body": "Historical running-rehabilitation note

Dates: March 21–25, 2025

March 21: Completed the first continuous easy run after the reduced-load progression: 15 minutes on the morning lake trail. The run was completed without a reported focal inside-right-ankle problem.

March 22 follow-up: Remained free of focal inside-right-ankle ache during ordinary walking and stairs the following morning. No return to the former three-mile routine and no third weekly run.

Limit for the rest of March: Two nonconsecutive short continuous easy runs per week. Running duration or frequency may increase within a week, but not both. Continue ankle-and-calf strengthening and the session-plus-following-day symptom rule. Do not add a third weekly run or return to the former three-mile routine.

Next planned short run: Tuesday morning, March 25, 2025, with a reduced-load 20-minute continuous easy-running limit. No pace or distance target; reserve transition time. Stop for focal inside-right-ankle ache and advance only when the session and following day remain symptom-free."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_028_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The note says Riley completed a first 15-minute continuous easy run on March 21, 2025 and remained free of the focal inside-right-ankle ache during next-morning walking and stairs; she would keep two nonconsecutive short runs per week for the rest of March rather than return to three-mile runs or add a third weekly run; and her next short run was planned for the morning of March 25.", "value": {"title": "Running Rehabilitation Note — March 21–25, 2025", "body": "Historical running-rehabilitation note

March 22 follow-up: Remained free of focal inside-right-ankle ache during ordinary walking and stairs the following morning. No return to the former three-mile routine and no third weekly run.

Continue ankle-and-calf strengthening and the session-plus-following-day symptom rule. Do not add a third weekly run or return to the former three-mile routine.
